title: ShenSMP Customized
description: Shenanigans SMP Resource Pack with all the custom hats,items, and/or tools.
body:
This resource pack helps show the customized hat,item, and/or tools made by others to give more life in the server!

![Straw Hat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc7a86add02261e9e49e72a43ac593020ed92b3d.png)

Here's the command to get the custom items! replace the item is and/or data number for the other items! **Look in the gallery for all the items that are added so far!**

/give @s minecraft:carved_pumpkin[minecraft:custom_model_data=1]

All custom hats,items and tools:
- Straw Hat (carved_pumpkin) ID:1 (Created By Tunips)
- Spooky Mask (carved_pumpkin) ID:2 (Created By: Fukubus)
